label: Authority reference
description: Source records a reference to an authority; not a verified grant.

label: Recorded contradiction
description: A contradiction has been recorded; this is not a text inference.

label: Informed by
description: Source records an informational input from target.

label: Part of
description: Source is represented as a part of target.

label: Related to
description: A declared relationship without dependency semantics.

label: Supersedes
description: Source records succession of target; no automatic retraction.
